content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. Work on GitHub issue #239 (read it with `gh issue view 239`, and AGENTS.md). This is PR 1 of several: one area per PR. Your area is the balance and dashboard calculations: `lib/finance/balances.ts`, `lib/finance/net-worth-source.ts`, `lib/finance/own-transfers.ts`, `lib/finance/dashboard-spending.ts`, `lib/finance/insights.ts`. Each of these imports `@/lib/auth`, `@/lib/settings` or `@/lib/all-pages`.

Owner's decision: callers (app pages, route handlers, server actions, chat/voice tools, workflows) resolve the owner/workspace, settings and clock; the lib/finance functions take plain inputs (a db client, workspace id, the narrow settings they need such as timeZone, and a `today`/`now` value). No dependency-injection framework. Authorization stays at each public entry point. Behaviour must not change. Do NOT add the lint ban yet; it comes in the last PR once all areas are migrated. Leave the other lib/finance files alone.

Steps: create branch `t3/issue-239-balances` from origin/main. Reproduce current behaviour first (existing tests). Migrate the five files and every caller (`git grep` them). Make existing tests need fewer request-state mocks (drop `vi.mock("@/lib/auth")`/settings mocks where they become unnecessary). Commit in steps with plain-language messages. Before opening the PR, merge origin/main again (resolve conflicts keeping main's changes; another PR is typing the database clients). Run `npm run feature-map` if lint asks.

Rules: run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"; commits end with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.

Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P2 (incremental follow-up).

## Problem and current evidence

The audit found lib/finance importing lib/auth, lib/settings and lib/all-pages. That couples deterministic calculations to requests and makes meaningful tests require many mocks. Counts in #224 are historical.

## Scope

Trace affected callers and move owner/workspace/settings resolution to the existing app or service boundary. Pass the database and narrow settings/clock inputs to operations. Keep calculations independent from auth, AI and request context. Prefer existing seams and avoid introducing a dependency-injection framework.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Financial calculations can run with explicit inputs and no request cookies.
- [ ] Authorization remains enforced at each public entry point.
- [ ] Chat, voice, pages, imports and background callers use the same calculations.
- [ ] Existing behaviour tests pass with fewer request-state mocks.
- [ ] Lint enforces the chosen boundary once migration is complete.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.

Only `own-transfers.ts` and `insights.ts` needed code changes in your area; the other three files had nothing to migrate. `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` all pass, and `own-transfers.live.test.ts` passes against moneo-qa.

- **Own-transfers:** `linkOwnTransfers` and `confirmOwnAccount` now take `{ locale, timezone, now }` instead of loading settings inside. The accounts server actions and `agent-apply.ts` pass the signed-in workspace's values. The import workflow reads the settings once in its step.
- **Insights:** `INSIGHT_TYPES` moved from `lib/settings.ts` to a new `lib/insight-types.ts`, so `lib/finance/insights.ts` no longer imports settings.
- **`balances.ts`, `net-worth-source.ts`, `dashboard-spending.ts`:** left alone. They only import `allPages`, a plain paging helper with no auth or settings. None of the five files ever imported `lib/auth`.
- **Mocks:** the tests for these five files already ran without request-state mocks, so there were none to drop.
- **Merge:** I merged origin/main and resolved the conflict in `own-transfers.ts`, keeping main's `Db` type.
- **Test runs:** the first full `npm test` run had one failing test I didn't identify. Two reruns passed (last: 324 files, 1863 tests, 17 skipped).

The PR notes the Speed section as no measurable change; the import workflow now does one settings read instead of up to three lazy ones.
